title: Imaging second read + discordance
description: Blindly review still images and cine video, preserve disagreement, and require clinician adjudication.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: imaging-second-read-discordance
  title: Imaging second read + discordance
  description: Blindly review still images and cine video, preserve disagreement, and require clinician adjudication.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce an independent imaging comparison without replacing credentialed clinical judgment.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [clinician-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: still-study
      kind: input
      name: Still imaging study
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, instructions]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string, contentMediaType: image/* }
          instructions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: image
    - id: cine-study
      kind: input
      name: Cine or motion study
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, instructions]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string, contentMediaType: video/* }
          instructions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: video
    - id: reader-a
      kind: agent
      name: Blind second read A
      templateRef: clin-02
      role: Independent second reader for credentialed imaging workflows.
      prompt: Perform an independent second read without seeing the first interpretation. Record findings, confidence, critical-result status, and limitations in the supplied rubric for clinician adjudication.
      capabilities: { skills: [image-understanding, independent-review, clinical-safety], tools: [read], permissions: [read-sensitive] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: reader-b
      kind: agent
      name: Blind second read B
      templateRef: clin-02
      role: Independent second reader for credentialed imaging workflows.
      prompt: Perform an independent second read without seeing the first interpretation. Record findings, confidence, critical-result status, and limitations in the supplied rubric for clinician adjudication.
      capabilities: { skills: [image-understanding, independent-review, clinical-safety], tools: [read], permissions: [read-sensitive] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: vote
      kind: aggregator
      name: Preserve concordance and ties
      config: { aggregation: vote }
    - id: clinician-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Credentialed clinician adjudicates discordance and critical findings
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Clinician-approved comparison
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: still-study, to: reader-a, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: cine-study, to: reader-a, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: still-study, to: reader-b, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: cine-study, to: reader-b, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: reader-a, to: vote, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: reader-b, to: vote, kind: data }
    - { id: e7, from: vote, to: clinician-approval, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e8, from: clinician-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
